Called by the browser after the product page rendered. Quotes one line (quantity 1) with delivery-promise POST /delivery-offers:quote for the postal prefix and joins the per-tier delivery charge from the current pricing charge schedule. A missing charge schedule only leaves the charge out. On a timeout the page keeps its enter-a-postal-code text. Each tier carries the quoted window's destination timeZone when delivery-promise sent one.
